entries.title: Moving your first mate asks for the room it really needs
entries.body: Before you move your first mate to another computer, its list now counts what the move writes there: your first mate's record once, your projects, and 20 GB kept free after the move, instead of twice the record. It says how much to free, checks a second disk where the move's files wait, and also says when the computer your first mate leaves lacks the room to prepare the move.

picture.alt: The list before moving your first mate to Mac mini, saying Mac mini has 57.0 GB free, the move needs about 108.2 GB, and to free about 51.2 GB there first

entries.noDocsSite: The docs site's Move your first mate section says a list first shows anything in the way, which stays true; it names no space figures.
